verdict.rationale: Radar documents a review queue for flagged or unusual payments. Risk insights in that queue surface the risk factors (signals) behind each decision. It also shows a network of related payments sharing the same customer ID, IP address, or card, which covers customer history and related cases. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of deeper customer-history views, similarity matching beyond shared identifiers, features that support consistent decisions across analysts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the review workflow.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, flagged transactions land in a review queue that shows the full context — customer history, signals, similar cases — so I can decide quickly and consistently

citations.quote: the review queue allows you to examine unusual payments, without having to review each payment individually
You can create a targeted list of payments to review with criteria that you specify, and review them in the Dashboard.
Risk insights shows you the risk factors that power Stripe Radar.
You can also view the network of related payments, which includes any other payments made to your business using the same customer ID, IP address, or card number
